{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.10

|gr1= GUI Control

|descr= Sets how to handle opening of URL, default browser or Steam overlay. Possible values:
* 0 - default browser
* 1 - Steam overlay if enabled, otherwise default browser 
* 2 - Steam overlay, shows error message box if disabled (the box has a button to continue with default browser)

{{Feature|informative|Toggling Steam overlay in Steam options will require game restart for the changes to take effect.}}

|s1= control [[ctrlSetURLOverlayMode]] mode

|p1= control: [[Control]] - control that contain url opening action
|p2= mode: [[Number]] - overlay mode, see description

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_control ctrlSetURLOverlayMode 1;</sqf>

|seealso= [[isSteamOverlayEnabled]] [[ctrlURLOverlayMode]] [[ctrlURL]] [[menuSetURL]]
}}
